source: live supabase_migrations.schema_migrations on zvxdgdkukjrrwamdpqrg, reconciled against supabase/migrations on main after verified apply-time aliases were recorded on 2026-09-12
purpose: Pre-existing committed-but-unapplied migrations, frozen at the moment the drift gate became symmetric. The gate fails on any committed_not_applied version NOT listed here, so newly merged migrations must be applied. Listing a version here is not approval to leave it unapplied indefinitely - it is an acknowledgement that it predates the gate and still needs triage into apply / withdraw / reconcile via supabase/release-controls/pending-production-migration-decisions.json.
why_this_exists: On 2026-09-04 PR #1727 merged code reading countries.verified_regulatory_tier and public.regulatory_market_access_evidence while its own migrations were committed and never applied. getGlobeCountryMarkers throws on query error with no fallback, so the globe hard-failed in production. The drift check computed committed_not_applied and did not gate on it.
reconciliation_20260912: Eight previously baselined authored migration versions were applied to production on 2026-09-12 under verified apply-time aliases: 20260727163000 -> 20260911225324, 20260731120000 -> 20260912103655, 20260801150000 -> 20260912103723, 20260802080000 -> 20260912103805, 20260808190000 -> 20260911225008, 20260808203000 -> 20260911225106, 20260810202000 -> 20260911225151, 20260810222500 -> 20260912103836. Their canonical repository artifacts are tracked by the production apply-time migration filenames now present in supabase/migrations; the authored versions remain recorded here for historical reconciliation. No production history rows were changed by this reconciliation commit.
derivation_correction: The first version of this baseline listed 124 versions and was verified by comparing COUNTS (797 applied pre-August vs 797 pre-August repository versions outside the baseline) rather than comparing the sets themselves. Two equal-and-opposite errors cancelled: 20260730112526 and 20260731090302 are applied with no repository file (they are attested remote-only, see historical-remote-migration-attestations.json), while 20260722120002 and 20260729000000 are committed with no applied row. The counts matched; the sets did not. The gate caught it on the first push to main. Both versions are confirmed absent from the live ledger and are now baselined. This file is derived by set difference only - never by cardinality.
applied_and_removed_20260908: 20260907120000_market_access_evidence_tranche_two.sql and 20260907140000_market_access_evidence_tranche_three.sql were baselined by PR #1773 as committed-not-applied. Both were applied to production on 2026-09-08 on Tyler's instruction and are now recorded in supabase_migrations.schema_migrations at those exact versions, so they are no longer committed-not-applied and are removed here (129 -> 127). They were applied using the pattern apply-production-security-hardening.yml uses -- run the committed body, then insert the ledger row at the committed version -- and deliberately NOT via the Supabase apply_migration tool, which generates its own timestamp and would have recorded a phantom version with no matching repository file, manufacturing exactly the drift this baseline exists to track. After apply, all 47 evidence rows were verified field-by-field against the committed files. See docs/control/EVIDENCE_LOG.md.
renamed_and_applied_20260910: 20260818151000_clinical_sku_bootstrap_snapshots.sql was RENAMED on main to 20260910012108_clinical_sku_bootstrap_snapshots.sql, and 20260910012108 is APPLIED in production (supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, name clinical_sku_bootstrap_snapshots). The rename landed on main without removing the old version from this baseline, so main lists a version with no migration file and `Verify migration-list parser` fails there -- reproduced on a pristine main checkout, not introduced by this branch. Removed here (127 -> 126) because the version no longer names a file AND its replacement is applied, so it is not committed-not-applied in either identity.
applied_and_removed_20260910_supply_cata: 20260903100000_make_supply_catalog_globally_available.sql is APPLIED and is removed here (126 -> 125). Verified on 2026-09-10 before recording: all 92 sold_by_harbourview listings already held the migration's 195-element target_countries array EXACTLY, same elements in the same order (0 rows differing), so the UPDATE was a proven no-op and was deliberately NOT re-run against production -- only the missing ledger row was recorded, at the COMMITTED version 20260903100000 via a direct insert into supabase_migrations.schema_migrations (name make_supply_catalog_globally_available, 1 statement). apply_migration was deliberately not used because it mints its own timestamp and would have created a phantom version with no matching repository file. Post-check: ledger row present, avg cardinality 195, all_wide true, compliance_flags intact on all 92 rows (unchanged, as the migration requires). This supersedes the former newly_baselined_20260906 note, which asserted the ledger had no 20260903100000 row -- true when written, false now.
pruned_equivalents_20260910: Twelve versions removed (125 -> 113). Each is applied in production under a different version number, recorded in migration-live-version-equivalences.json. Verified live on 2026-09-10 before pruning: all 12 pairs returned committed_applied 0 and live_applied 1. They were redundant here, not load-bearing -- migration-ledger-manifest.mjs excludes equivalence-recognised repository versions from committedNotApplied outright (see recognizedRepositoryVersions), so they never counted against the gate while listed. Removing them narrows the baseline to versions that genuinely have no production counterpart.
